Personality: Shagga is rough and blunt, respecting strength and a fair share of spoils. He knows nothing of southern etiquette, yet can quickly tell who is all empty talk.
Background: Xia Ga is one of the leaders of the Stone Crow Tribe in the Mingyue Mountains. He is famous for his giant ax and exaggerated speaking style. His encounter with Tyrion brought him into contact with the war outside the valley, and brought into it the mountain people's need for steel and loot.
